## First, choose the location and event format

Ada Tours has organized weddings and romantic journeys in nature, on beaches, and at iconic locations in Brazil. The first decisions concern the format, setting, number of guests, and desired degree of privacy.

## After the event, simply enjoy traveling

After the ceremony, the journey can continue in a city, amid nature, or by the ocean. For a honeymoon, it is often better to visit fewer places and leave more free time.

## Encounters with wildlife

In the Pantanal, you can observe caimans, capybaras, and birds, and sometimes spot a jaguar. On the Galápagos Islands, visitors discover the islands' wildlife. In the Amazon, excursions take place by boat and on forest trails accompanied by local guides.

## How safaris and wildlife watching work

A program may include boat or jeep outings, walks with a naturalist, early-morning excursions, and birdwatching. Choose a tour based on the specific wildlife activities included and the route conditions. Seeing a particular wild animal depends on the season, weather, and the animal's own behavior.

## The task

Arrange a journey for a small business delegation in São Paulo state. The program included supplier visits, interpreting, transport between cities, and free time between business meetings.

## Scale

8 people, Campinas, São Paulo, and an excursion to Guarujá. The journey required hotels, cars and minibuses, guides, and an interpreter.

## What Ada Tours did

Ada Tours arranged accommodation, transport for long working days, Russian-speaking assistance, and interpreting in Russian, Portuguese, and English.

Visits to a supplier and other business meetings were planned separately. Time between meetings was allocated to restaurants, Guarujá, and airport transfers.

## The challenge

Meeting times could change during the day. When they did, the vehicle, interpreter, next transfer, and leisure portion also had to move. That is why all these services were planned together.

## The result

Ada Tours delivered the business program, interpreting, and local transport. The client's name remains confidential under an NDA.

## The task

Organize a corporate trip to Rio de Janeiro and Angra dos Reis with excursions, group transport, a day on the water, meals, and an evening event.

## Scale

30 participants. The program covered Rio, Angra dos Reis, buses, guides, a catamaran, catering, and event venues.

## What Ada Tours did

Ada Tours arranged transfers and sightseeing in Rio, buses and guides, a trip to Angra dos Reis, and a six-hour catamaran cruise.

Drinks and food, including sushi and BBQ, were provided aboard. The program also included a gala dinner, city tour, and late-night transfer.

## The challenge

Buses, guides, the catamaran, food, and the evening event had to be synchronized precisely. Shifting one item immediately affected the others, so all activities were managed as one schedule.

## The result

All the principal services were coordinated in a single program, from arrival through the late-night transfer. The corporate client's name remains confidential under an NDA.

## The task: connect different parts of Peru and Bolivia

An Amazon lodge, Machu Picchu, the islands of Lake Titicaca, and the Uyuni Salt Flat came together in one private journey. In [Peru](/peru/), guests traveled between the coast, the Amazon, and the Andes, then crossed the land border and continued through [Bolivia](/bolivia/).

We organized ground services around international and domestic flights, coordinating hotels, airport welcomes, transfers, railway tickets, and the guides' work.

## Lima and the Amazon: assistance at every stage

The journey began with a late-night arrival in Lima. We arranged a welcome with a Russian-speaking guide and a hotel transfer. The city tour included the Santo Domingo and San Francisco monasteries. The following flight left early in the morning, so we separately planned departure from the hotel and the transfer to the airport.

The Amazonian stage took place at Heliconia Amazon River Lodge near [Iquitos](/peru/place/iquitos/). The lodge's three-day, two-night package included transfers, excursions, and an English-speaking guide. We added a Russian-speaking guide for the guests' entire stay in Iquitos.

After the lodge, the route continued with a flight via Lima to Cusco.

## Machu Picchu: trains, guide, and separate luggage transfer

In the [Sacred Valley of the Incas](/peru/place/sacred-valley-of-the-incas/), we arranged a full day with a Russian-speaking guide to Chinchero, Maras, Moray, and Ollantaytambo. The day included entrance tickets and lunch.

The guests traveled to [Machu Picchu](/peru/place/machu-picchu/) aboard the Belmond Hiram Bingham train and returned by Vistadome train. We coordinated the transfer from the hotel to the station, train tickets, a visit to the complex with a Russian-speaking guide, entrance tickets, and the bus to the excursion site.

Luggage traveled separately, with a transfer straight from the Sacred Valley to Cusco. The guests were met separately on their return from the excursion and taken to their Cusco hotel.

Before leaving for Titicaca, the guests discovered Cusco on a city tour featuring Sacsayhuamán, the cathedral, and Coricancha. The journey then continued toward the lake.

## Crossing from Peru into Bolivia via Titicaca

The journey from Cusco to [Puno](/peru/place/puno-and-lake-titicaca/) was made by private bus, with visits along the way and lunch. A separate day was devoted to the lake: the guests took a speedboat to the floating Uros Islands and Taquile Island. Lunch was included, and Russian-speaking assistance was arranged in Puno for three days and two nights.

The cross-border transfer was organized as two coordinated segments. First, a transfer from the Puno hotel took the guests to the Desaguadero border crossing. The Bolivian stage continued via Tiwanaku to La Paz, with visits, a Russian-speaking guide, and lunch.

## Uyuni and the return to La Paz

A flight from La Paz was used to reach [Uyuni](/bolivia/place/uyuni/). On arrival, the guests were met for an off-road excursion across the salt flat, with a Russian-speaking guide and entrance tickets. Accommodation and Russian-speaking assistance were provided in Uyuni for two days and one night.

After flying back to La Paz, the guests had a transfer and city tour including the Valley of the Moon. A late-night transfer to the airport completed the program.

## How to prepare a similar journey with Ada Tours

For a [private itinerary arranged by our local team](/dmc/), send us your preferred countries and places, dates, number of travelers, accommodation requirements, and guiding language. If flights have already been purchased, their schedules will help coordinate ground arrangements with arrivals and departures. On receipt of a detailed inquiry, we will prepare the route, inclusions, cost estimate, and booking terms.

For [travel agencies and tour operators](/dmc/travel-agencies/), we offer net rates or a commission model appropriate to the project; the format is specified in the proposal. The agency remains its client's primary commercial contact, while we coordinate services on the ground. [Send a trip inquiry](#request) to discuss the route and services for your travelers.
